strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with per-stage rescaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with local scale/unscale operations between each stage, following the reference pattern. Each iteration applies per-shard scaling (a[r]), divides by W, reduces, then unscales. Total 8 all-reduce dispatches plus local elementwise ops. Straightforward translation with no optimization—highest dispatch count but simplest structure.

strategies.name: Fused local operations between collectives
strategies.desc: Reduces dispatch overhead by vectorizing all per-shard scale/unscale operations into single kernel launches instead of separate loops. Uses tensor slicing with in-place operations or torch.cat to batch the W shard transformations. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but minimizes local op overhead between stages. Trades off slight code complexity for better local compute efficiency.

strategies.name: Pipelined dual-buffer all-reduce chain
strategies.desc: Overlaps computation and communication by alternating between two buffers across the 8 stages, eliminating explicit clone() calls. While one buffer is in all-reduce, the next stage's local scaling operations prepare the other buffer. Maintains 8 all-reduce dispatches but hides local computation latency behind communication. Best for communication-bound scenarios with sufficient compute slack.

strategies.name: Precomputed scale tensor broadcast pattern
strategies.desc: Precomputes a scale tensor encoding all per-shard coefficients (a[r]/W and 1/a[r]) as a (W, S) view, then uses broadcasted multiply instead of loops. Restructures each stage as: elementwise multiply with scale view, all-reduce, elementwise multiply with inverse scale view. Still 8 all-reduces but local ops become single vectorized operations. Optimizes memory access patterns at cost of initial setup.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter + all-gather decomposition per stage
strategies.desc:
Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, allowing local scaling to operate on smaller W*S/W=S chunks between the two primitives. Each of 8 stages becomes reduce-scatter (apply scale locally on small shard), all-gather (broadcast), then unscale. Total 16 collective dispatches but each moves less data and enables different communication topology optimizations on multi-node setups.
